scope: direct index startup with metadata + content verification; daemon measured separately

daemon.note: daemon process memory includes the resident engine and is not comparable to the direct CLI process RSS/PSS

correctness: same-size/same-mtime content change is detected by content fingerprint and forces normal pipeline content recheck; FTS/vector freshness test passes
delete invalidates the fast path and refreshes the sidecar
missing and corrupt sidecars fall back to normal indexing and are replaced
sidecar requires indexed manifest, existing storage, generation/index version, metadata and content fingerprints
explicit changes, rebuild, scan/model options and skipped files bypass the fast path
ZGM2 manifests remain 2000/2000, no legacy JSON manifests
sidecar v4 includes storage metadata seal; ctime/inode changes force content recheck
limits: single host/single run per incremental/rebuild condition
no OS page-cache drop; cold I/O not forced
storage seal is metadata-derived; deep data-page corruption still requires opening storage
a source change that fully reverts during one index attempt remains a TOCTOU window
daemon comparison is client latency plus resident daemon PSS, not direct process RSS
